name: Conflict of Memory
source:
An Achillean VN taking place in late 19th Century France.

A vampire is on trial for murder, and a priest has to decide whether he can be declared insane while posing as a Doctor before the vampire is sentenced to death.

[Edited fom [url=https://olesgedz.itch.io/conflict-of-memory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场发生在19世纪末法国的阿喀琉斯式VN。

一名吸血鬼因谋杀罪受审，一名牧师必须决定在吸血鬼被判处死刑之前，他冒充医生时是否可以被宣布为精神错乱。

[编辑自[url=https://olesgedz.itch.io/conflict-of-memory]itch.io[/url]]
